title: Report unprojectable restored records as typed integrity findings during projection repair and name the rebuilt tables in shipped.md
outcome: Report unprojectable restored records as typed integrity findings during projection repair and name the rebuilt tables in shipped.md
acceptance: A work_restored_record whose work item is missing makes doctor --repair-projections report each malformed restored record as a typed integrity finding, continue checking the remaining rows so the report is complete, and refuse with a rollback, committing no partial repair, claiming no healthy result and deleting no data; docs/shipped.md names work_restored_records and work_restored_evidence as rebuilt projections.

completion.summary: Landed d9c250c (bundle 5C): projection repair names each restored record, restored evidence or observation it cannot project (decode, generation range, missing item, planning basis, constraint) as a typed finding, still rebuilds and verifies every other row, then refuses with the complete list and rolls back: no partial commit, no healthy result, no deletion. Operational failures remain errors, and valid stores rebuild exactly as before. shipped.md names work_observations, work_restored_records and work_restored_evidence.
